title: Generated-documentation format
explanation: Assumed extractor facts: a document with generated, provenance, validated, and indexed booleans.

cases.original: Every generated document carries a provenance header: `Generated from <model> by <script> — do not edit by hand.`
cases.note: The rule flags a generated document without a provenance header; the header's exact text is the generator's job, not the rule's.
cases.suggestion: Keep the header's literal text in the generator, not in the rule.

cases.original: The generator provides a validation mode that checks the model and exits nonzero on errors.
cases.note: The rule requires a validation mode; it does not check that the mode actually runs.
cases.suggestion: State that the validation mode runs under make test, as a separate rule.

cases.original: The documents index (`documents/README.md`) marks generated documents as generated.
cases.note: The rule flags a generated document missing from the index's generated list.
